component.name: ButtonArrow
component.description: 32px circular prev/next navigation button. Uses an Icon chevron internally. direction prop selects left or right. Disabled state: no background, muted icon, pointer-events blocked. Used in carousel paginators and chapter/slider navigators.

useWhen: Navigating backward or forward through a carousel of cards
Stepping through chapters or slides in a sequence
Disabling the left arrow when at the start of a sequence, and the right arrow at the end

notFor.case: Using ButtonArrow as a general-purpose icon button
notFor.because: ButtonArrow is sized and styled for directional sequence navigation only. Its small 32px size and circular shape signal a specific role.
notFor.note: Use Button with shape=round for general icon-only actions.

useWhen.left: Chevron-left icon. Navigates to the previous item. Set disabled when at the start of the sequence.
useWhen.right: Chevron-right icon. Navigates to the next item. Set disabled when at the end of the sequence.
